description: kitr new --kit saas: A logged-in product on its own API: sign-in, a guarded app shell, a projects CRUD with a data table, analytics and monitoring. Server-rendered web plus an API server.

kitr.name: saas
kitr.title: SaaS kit
kitr.summary: Start a logged-in product on its own API: sign-in, a guarded shell, a projects CRUD, analytics.

kit.audience: Founders and teams starting a signed-in product: accounts, a guarded app and a first resource to build on.

highlights.title: Accounts that work
highlights.text: Sign-in, sign-up, email verification and password reset, on HttpOnly cookie sessions with CSRF protection.

highlights.title: A guarded app shell
highlights.text: Every page under the `_app` layout needs a session; abilities decide what each role sees.

highlights.title: A real resource
highlights.text: Projects: a data table, a create form and an API, sharing one schema in `app/validators/projects.ts`.

highlights.title: Production pieces
highlights.text: Mail, rate limits and security headers, analytics and error monitoring are already configured.

run: The app and its API; sign in as admin@example.com with the password password
Both platforms; production needs `SESSION_SECRET` and a mail transport
Vitest, starting with the API test
